description: This file defines TLS and SSL method collections and object handling routines for mbedTLS within a websocket framework. It sets up various client, server, and general method collections using macros, along with implementations for getting X509 and private key objects.

methods.name: x509_pm_new
methods.description: Creates a new X509 object instance.

methods.name: x509_pm_load
methods.description: Loads certificate data into an X509 object.

methods.name: x509_pm_show_info
methods.description: Displays information about an X509 object.

methods.name: pkey_pm_new
methods.description: Creates a new private key object instance.

methods.name: pkey_pm_free
methods.description: Frees a private key object instance.

methods.name: pkey_pm_load
methods.description: Loads private key data into an object.
